purpose: Independent coarse daily-price screen of public XMOON/ATA signal components; not a reproduction of proprietary source and not an executable DEX backtest.

signal.long_three_push: three successively lower price pivot lows and three successively higher RSI pivot lows
signal.execution_note: For forward-return diagnostics, anchor at the next available daily close after confirmation; no same-bar action is claimed.

variants.B: A + close above daily SMA200 at confirmation
variants.E: C signals + equal 4-step basket path diagnostic
variants.F: C signals + linear 1:2:3:4 4-step basket path diagnostic

omitted_in_this_coarse_screen.D: extra confluence is not defined from daily close-only archive
omitted_in_this_coarse_screen.G: inverse-vol step weighting is not meaningful without a preregistered per-step volatility mapping
omitted_in_this_coarse_screen.note: Omission is declared before results and is not a post-hoc result choice.

dca_path_diagnostic.fill_rule: diagnostic only: a step is considered reached on the first observed daily close at or below its level; fill value uses that observed close

anti_overfit: No parameter changes after opening final OOS results.
Existing Arz WETH/Base holdout must not be used to tune this screen.
Daily close-only findings are screening evidence, not execution-quality evidence.
No live-capital decision can be upgraded from this screen alone.
